***IMPORTANT FOR #BBA STUDENTS***
***APPLICABLE FROM #143 BATCH***
We people are confused about history, pol and pad courses. Biggest confusion is, which one do we need to complete or which one don't. So the answer is..........
From #Humanities section we have to complete 9 credit I mean 3 courses where Philosophy (PHI401) and Emergence of Bangladesh (HIS103) is mandatory. Now you have to choose/complete another 1 course from HIS101/HIS205.
So, total 9 credit I mean 3 courses are done from #Humanities section.
Now, you have to complete 6 credit I mean 2 courses from #Social_Science section where you have to choose any one from SOC101/GEO205/ANT101. So, 3 credit done.
#Note: If anyone done with SOC then no need to take GEO or ANT anymore or anyone done with GEO then no need to take SOC or ANT. If anyone takes that mistakenly then that will be considered as open elective course. Thats why dual major people should know this properly.
For another 3 credit you have to choose any one course from POL101/POL104/PAD201.
#Note: If anyone done with POL101 then no need to take POL104 or PAD201 anymore or done with PAD201 then no need to take POL104 or POL101. If anyone takes that mistakenly that will be counted as open elective course. Again dual major people should know about this properly.
So total 6 credit I mean 2 courses are done from #Social_Science section.
Don't ask anyone "Which one is easy between POL and PAD?." Think before ask it. Because you have to complete one course either POL or PAD. So, whoever is done with POL, he/she will say POL is easy because he/she doesn't complete PAD and vice-versa.
